{{Top}}
{{MoreSources}}
{{Quote|I may not know what many things are in your world – but I know what they ''weigh.|[[T1-LB|Elbee]] the [[LB-series bulk-loading droid|bulk loader]]|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 47">[[Knights of the Old Republic 47|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 47]]</ref>}}
A '''kilogram''' ('''kilo''' or '''kg''' for short) was a measurement of mass.

==History==
[[Wendell Wright-Sims]], a prominent [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Drug dealer|dealer]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], often delivered several kilograms of the choicest spice to [[Dark Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], free of charge, to maintain Xizor's favor.
